record.paper_title: Banach spaces and Ramsey Theory: some open problems
record.original_question: Is every complemented subspace of C[0,1] isomorphic to a space C(K) for some closed subset K of [0,1]?

evidence.quote: Problem 9. (Complemented Subspace Problem for C[0, 1] – see [12, 52, 63]) Is it true that every complemented subspace of C[0, 1] is isomorphic to a C(K) space for some closed subset K of [0, 1].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C[0,1]$ denote the Banach space of real-valued continuous functions on the unit interval $[0,1]$, equipped with the supremum norm. For a compact Hausdorff space $K$, let $C(K)$ denote the Banach space of real-valued continuous functions on $K$ with the supremum norm. A closed subspace $X$ of a Banach space $Y$ is said to be complemented in $Y$ if there exists a bounded linear projection $P:Y\to Y$ with $P(Y)=X$.

Question: Is it true that every complemented (infinite-dimensional) subspace of $C[0,1]$ is isomorphic, as a Banach space, to $C(K)$ for some closed subset $K\subseteq[0,1]$?
artifact.status_search_result: The general complemented subspace problem for C(K)-spaces was recently answered negatively by Plebanek and Salguero-Alarcón, who exhibited a 1-complemented subspace of a C(K)-space that is not isomorphic to any C(K). However, the separable version specific to C[0,1] — whether every complemented subspace of C[0,1] is isomorphic to C(K) for some closed K ⊆ [0,1] — appears to remain open as of recent surveys.

status_evidence.title: The complemented subspace problem for C(K)-spaces: A counterexample
status_evidence.snippet: A 1-complemented subspace PS2 of a C(K)-space is exhibited which is not isomorphic to any C(K)-space.
status_evidence.claim: The general C(K) complemented subspace problem has been resolved negatively, but this does not settle the separable case for C[0,1].

status_evidence.title: Complementability of separable spaces C(K) in Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: It is conjectured that every complemented subspace of C[0,1] is isomorphic to a C(K)-space, and this problem is still open.
status_evidence.claim: The separable problem for complemented subspaces of C[0,1] remains open.
